name: Post in a Room
description: Posts in a room as the caller: the post records who made it, and the access token it came through, from the request itself. Needs room/post on x/room/<name>, unless the room lets anyone post. Returns the post, whose number n is where to wait from for what follows it.

room.description: The room's name: 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, such as tau-collab.

text.description: What to say, as plain text.

output.description: A post: n (its number in the room, from 0), ts (when, in milliseconds since 1970), from (the DID of whoever posted), via (the access token it came through, when one did) and text.
